breaking.change: prefer-nullish-coalescing: ignoreConditionalTests defaults to true

breaking.change: Dot globs are enabled for project by default
breaking.quote: enable dot globs for project by default

breaking.change: The no-loss-of-precision extension rule is deprecated
breaking.quote: deprecate no-loss-of-precision extension rule

breaking.change: Formatting and layout rules were removed
breaking.quote: remove formatting/layout rules

breaking.change: The slow deprecated and isolated programs were removed
breaking.quote: remove slow deprecated and isolated programs

breaking.change: TSEnumDeclaration has a TSEnumBody node (AST)
breaking.quote: add TSEnumBody node for TSEnumDeclaration body

breaking.change: automaticSingleRunInference was renamed to disallowAutomaticSingleRunInference
breaking.quote: rename automaticSingleRunInference to disallowAutomaticSingleRunInference

breaking.change: Deprecated type params were removed from the AST spec
breaking.quote: remove deprecated type params

breaking.change: The IsNullableTypeOptions interface was removed
breaking.quote: remove IsNullableTypeOptions interface

breaking.change: no-unused-vars handles catch like ESLint 9
breaking.quote: [no-unused-vars] align catch behavior to ESLint 9

breaking.change: The ESLint export of utils is FlatESLint instead of LegacyESLint
breaking.quote: swap LegacyESLint out for FlatESLint as ESLint export

breaking.change: no-empty-object-type was split out of ban-types and no-empty-interface
breaking.quote: split no-empty-object-type out from ban-types and no-empty-interfaces

breaking.change: RuleCreator rule meta.docs typing changed
breaking.quote: allow specifying additional rule meta.docs in RuleCreator

breaking.change: The shared configs changed for v8
breaking.quote: apply initial config changes for v8

breaking.change: ban-types was replaced by no-restricted-types, no-unsafe-function-type and no-wrapper-object-types
breaking.quote: replace ban-types with no-restricted-types, no-unsafe-function-type, no-wrapper-object-types

breaking.change: EXPERIMENTAL_useSourceOfProjectReferenceRedirect was removed
breaking.quote: remove EXPERIMENTAL_useSourceOfProjectReferenceRedirect

breaking.change: no-useless-template-literals was removed
breaking.quote: remove no-useless-template-literals

breaking.change: getTokenAtPosition was removed from type-utils
breaking.quote: remove getTokenAtPosition

breaking.change: no-floating-promises: checkThenables is off by default
breaking.quote: [no-floating-promises] disable checkThenables by default for v8

breaking.change: RuleTester uses flat config
breaking.quote: switched to flat config

breaking.change: The deprecated no-throw-literal rule was removed
breaking.quote: remove deprecated no-throw-literal rule

breaking.change: projectService is also removed in withoutProjectParserOptions
breaking.quote: also remove projectService in withoutProjectParserOptions

breaking.change: Deprecated context helpers were removed from utils
breaking.quote: remove deprecated context helpers
